thread:
Aisha: Quick check-in — orbit customer launch is in scope for next sprint. Need to finalize priority lanes and identify cross-team blockers for the sprint bakeoff. 30m sync this afternoon?
Carlos: +1. Do we have the final customer requirements we should bake towards (SLA/region/KMS)?
Aisha: Short list: 1) p95 latency target ~300ms for typical chat workloads, 2) regional data residency (eu-west, aws), 3) one customer requires HSM-backed keys, 4) burst capacity 2x baseline for launch windows. Doc: https://redwood.docs/rd/orbit-reqs (tl;dr in thread).
Jun: Runtime note — 300ms is achievable on dedicated A100/RTX with KV cache + quantized model for seq<=512, but cold starts will blow it. We need prefix caching + prewarm hooks for launch windows.
Priya: From infra: we can reserve a small dedicated pool (4 nodes) for the first two weeks, but that needs a commitment by EOD Friday to get capacity in the region. Otherwise we fall back to burst-scaling which has higher latencies during spin-up.
Evan: Security: HSM requirement forces Private (customer-managed HSM) or a high-trust Dedicated with KMS integration proof. Also need audit logs + key rotation SLA. Private adds ~2 sprints to timeline for infra and compliance checks.
Leo: So decision tradeoffs: Hosted (faster, lower lead time) vs Private (compliance, slower). Product input: which customers must be satisfied at T0?
Aisha: We have 3 paying customers on the pilot: two are OK with hosted + SOC2 controls, one mandates HSM. Proposal: staged rollout — Hosted for 2 customers at T0, Private or Dedicated+HSM for the third in parallel as limited pilot.
Carlos: Technical implications: if we do staged rollout we need routing policy to pin the HSM customer to Private/dedicated. Also rollout rules for fallback to smaller model under load. Simple policy sketch:```rollout:
  canary: 10%
  metric: p95_latency
  fallback: model-small
```
Jun: Also need config for prewarm/autoscale. Example we can ship as a runtime policy:```prewarm:
  window: 300s
  keep_warm: 2
  trigger: scheduled, spike_detect
```
Priya: Ops checklist: 1) reserve nodes (region) 2) network peering for Private 3) KMS/HSM contract 4) staging test (load + failover). Reserve request if we go dedicated: PUT by Fri -> capacity proc.
Evan: Compliance checklist: - HSM attestations - audit log retention (1yr) - TLS mutual auth for admin plane. If we choose Dedicated+HSM, security will need a runbook for key compromise scenarios.
Aisha: Action items: - @Carlos: estimate engineering delta for routing + canary fallback (ETA Tue) - @Jun: prewarm + cache config and perf estimate (ETA Tue) - @Priya: capacity quote / procurement timeline (ETA Fri) - @Evan: compliance gating list + minimal acceptance criteria for HSM customer (ETA Wed) - @Leo: coordinate customer comms and rollout windows (ETA Fri).
Carlos: fine. One more ask — can we get a lightweight observable for token-level latency on the canary? need p50/p95/p99 split and inflight queue length.
Jun: I'll add a per-route metric and a dashboard. Can simulate traffic using the perf harness.
Aisha: OK let's meet 2pm. If anyone can't, drop a quick note here and we can re-slot. :calendar:
Leo: 2pm works. I'll post a short agenda and bring the customer rep notes.
deploy-bot: scheduled meeting created: #product-sync 2pm today — agenda: scope tradeoffs, capacity commit, compliance gating.
Aisha: Thanks all — want this documented before EOD so leadership has a clear yes/no for capacity procurement. Will follow up with the decision matrix after the 2pm sync. :thumbsup:
